steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-00214 CUE/BIN with all 20 tracks. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use your own disc-images files plus scripts/build-macos.sh and scripts/run-macos.sh; no playable builds distributed. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.
